about: Appendix F Part 3 Stage 5 and C.22: the canaries that deliver a Tier 2 proposal's parameter changes to a small share of real Mentor sessions before release. Each entry names the H.7 experiment created in the staff experiment console (surface tutor, target mentor.canary, adults_only, no upper age bound), the proposal it delivers, the proposal's parameterChanges as overrides, and a status: `running` (Core delivers it) or `concluded` (kept as the proposal's Stage 5 evidence, never delivered). Core resolves the arm at session start (backend/src/services/pedagogy/mentorCanary.ts), Oracle applies the overrides only to registry Tier 2 parameters, clamped to their bounds (oracle/src/tutor/mentorCanary.ts). `share` is the share of eligible sessions in the canary arm; a matched control arm of the same size records exposure with no override. Generated into both services by `node agent/tools/check-mentor-canary-parity.mjs --write`; `npm run canary:check` and `npm run governance:check` verify it. Ending or rolling back a canary: conclude its experiment in the console (no new assignment at once), then set the entry to `concluded` and regenerate. This file is Tier 1 (component governance.model): every change needs a Tier 1 change-record row. Policy: docs/rebuild/mentor/SELF-IMPROVEMENT-GOVERNANCE-POLICY.md section 4.1.
